variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 59:10 reads 'My God with his lovingkindness will meet me': the third-person suffix 'his lovingkindness' renders the ketiv חסדו, not the qere חַסְדִּי ('my lovingkindness', as in the KJV's 'the God of my mercy'). The verse's only note (alternative_rendering, on 'mine enemies') concerns English wording elsewhere and does not bear on this unit.
